admission.justification: The budget test checks every fresh compiled capsule, declared detail and the digest against the current record and the frozen registries; without it an overgrown capsule or a silently edited registry would break instruction composition unnoticed.

applicability: Every compiled role, operation and launcher capsule cell, every manifest-declared step detail and the shared every-role digest, as recorded in skills/l-01-agent-lifecycles/capsule-budgets-current.json and wire_budget.py.
conditions: Compiled capsule ceilings come from authored COMPILED_CAPSULE_TOKEN_CEILINGS in wire_budget.py (o200k_base tokens); legacy word-ceiling enforcement and current_limits are retired while word counts remain informational in derived.current_measurements.
The checks compare freshly compiled sizes and source identities with generated measurements; growth under an authored token ceiling has no individual word budget.
The retained registry, snapshot helper, predecessor record and predecessor helper are authenticated by their historical hashes.
exclusions: Ordinary linked templates are measured without a ceiling.
The digest map is renewable and is not authenticated as frozen history.
The separate handover-projection token obligation retains its own record.
A size check does not establish semantic, audience or acceptance correctness.
The frozen historical registries' cells and budget formula are not current guarantees.

evidence: capsule-sizes.json (era 62748, a1b7 109616, master 107226, final 93905); sync-check 9/9; F07 memo for launcher/orientation +57 and architect/recovery +17

statement: The current capsule-budget record holds generated measurements and source identities for every compiled capsule cell, declared step detail, ordinary template and shared digest; checks reject stale or missing measurements, orphan membership and compiled capsule token growth beyond COMPILED_CAPSULE_TOKEN_CEILINGS in wire_budget.py (with legacy word-ceiling enforcement retired), while frozen historical registries and their retained checkers remain authenticated.
title: Current capsule budget record tracks fresh measurements and token ceilings
